t: The Active FE Power Port allows you to insert and extract energy from the Energizer.$(br2)Any Forge Energy-compatible cable or machine can be connected to the Active FE Power Port. The port will automatically transfer energy to the connected block if it supports it.
主动 FE 能量端口可以让你向充能器输入和从中提取能量。$(br2)任何兼容 Forge 能量的线缆或机器都可以连接到主动 FE 能量端口。如果连接的方块支持，端口会自动向其传输能量。
$(l)Mandatory:$() no$(br)$(l)Valid positions:$() any face (not on frame)$(br)$(l)Graphical interface:$() yes
$(l)必需：$()否$(br)$(l)有效位置：$()任意面（不能在框架上）$(br)$(l)图形界面：$()是
